prose.subject: Payment Required: API Report Access
prose.body:
Hello,

You requested access to our detailed supply chain analytics report via the API. To unlock the full dataset, a payment of 4974.20 USDC is required. This report contains comprehensive inventory levels, vendor performance metrics, and forecasted demand trends for the current quarter, allowing you to optimize procurement strategies with high confidence.

Please send the payment to the following address:
0x51e3332d43292a632fc19b0d6bd732beae3218ec

Once the transaction is confirmed on the network, the API will automatically update your access status, and the full JSON response will be available for download. No further action is needed on your part after the transfer is initiated. Our system monitors the payment address continuously, so you should receive immediate notification once access is granted.

If you have any questions regarding the invoice or the data scope, please reply to this email. We appreciate your business and look forward to supporting your supply chain operations.

Best regards,
The Juniper Supply Team
